title: Anime 132 · 콜로설 · 호홀로마 · 정면
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation illustration, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

Style: A high-quality Japanese anime key visual illustration, clean cel shading, crisp confident line art, vibrant saturated colors, polished professional anime art — not a photograph.

Subject: ONE mature adult Black woman in her early 40s with clearly adult facial features, long finger waves falling past her shoulders, a serene regal expression. She wears large teardrop studs and has square nails with a glass-like shine.

Physique: Deep near-black skin tone, THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, void complexion, not brown, not blue, not lightened, her face exactly as dark as her body. EXTREME COLOSSAL PHYSIQUE THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE, exaggerated far beyond real anatomy, around 1,000 pounds — a giantess built on a completely even scale, every part of her enlarged by the same amount: massive rounded shoulders, huge thick arms, a colossal full bust, a broad heavy torso with a large smooth rounded belly, wide solid hips, enormous columnar thighs and thick heavy calves, a full round face. No single part stands out more than another, no hanging rolls and no folds, not pregnant, her whole body scaled up together into one immense smooth silhouette that towers over the viewer. Her body fills the full width of the frame.

Body Art: Full body Russian Khokhloma body painting on her bare skin from the collarbones to the ankles, a glossy black lacquer ground covered with brilliant scarlet berries, curling golden strawberry vines and flame-gold leaves, a thick gold vine band following every deep crease and curve, dense berry scrolls filling the space between every band. The pattern covers the entire bust densely with no open gaps, and wraps fully around the rear, the lower belly, the knees and the calves, covering them as densely as the chest.

Pose: Standing upright full frontal with her feet planted apart, arms hanging relaxed away from the body, her full immense silhouette clear against the background, full body head to toe.

Footwear: Extreme scarlet platform stiletto sandals with double ankle straps, the platform soles as tall as her ankle bones, the ultra-thin stiletto heels so high her insteps stand nearly vertical.

Background & Lighting: A bright pale warm-sand stylized background, lighter than her body, warm light from one side, broad sweeping shadows across the great curves of the torso, hips and thighs showing their scale, the scarlet and gold blazing, glossy anime highlights on every curve.
